messages:
maria: :rotating_light: Getting reports that pages aren't reaching oncall for the last ~8m. incident-bot shows pages queued but no PD ring. Seeing pagerduty webhook 502 spikes in prod logs. anyone oncall?
jordan: @maria seeing the same from logs. 502s from pager-proxy -> notify-relay -> pd-webhook chain. quick tail from relay: 
```json
{"time":"2026-03-18T15:02:12Z","level":"error","msg":"502 from pd","service":"notify-relay","attempt":2}
```
ryan: I'm primary oncall, confirming no incoming calls to my phone. got an SMS earlier but no ring.
inc-bot: Automated escalation attempted and failed: pagerbridge->notify-relay returned 502. Attempts 1/3, 2/3 logged.
eng-bridge: we pushed a header-rewrite change to `notify-relay` last night to normalize attachments. rolling back now to previous image SHA.
maria: can someone manual-page the affected incidents and put a fallback route to PD legacy endpoint? :phone:
jordan: manual curl example to hit PD if needed: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"routing_key":"REDACTED","event_action":"trigger","payload":{"summary":"manual page","severity":"critical"}}'
```
ryan: starting manual pages for the ones we can recover. clients A and B got calls after manual trigger, thanks.
eng-bridge: rollback applied, doing `kubectl rollout restart deploy/notify-relay` on prod now. watching logs.
inc-bot: Notice: queued pages are now being delivered. 3 queued pages retried and delivered. :white_check_mark:
maria: good. please confirm customer impact (who missed rings, SLA exposure).
ryan: preliminary: ~5% of pages missed initial ring window, one customer opened support ticket and escalated. will add timeline to the incident ticket.
jordan: root cause likely header rewrite caused PD signature mismatch under load; PR #4321 contains the faulty change. I'll open the PR revert + longer-term fix. :memo:
maria: add runbook note to prefer legacy endpoint fallback when relay error rate > 1% and ensure manual-page steps documented. thanks all, closing coordination here.
